additional-stop-message: Drive the context-handoff POC to the spec in '1. claude-cli-context-handoff-poc.md' and '2. manual-context-persistence.md'. HARD RULES: test-first only, write the interface test before the implementation; look things up from official docs before coding; prove unknowns with a tiny standalone spike, never by running the whole app; reduce complexity, do not add it; do not drift from the spec and do not compromise. Integration-test budget is 20 real runs total - spend them only to confirm a fix that is already grounded in evidence. Record open questions and deferred issues in OPEN-QUESTIONS.md rather than asking. Set auto-resume to false when the spec is met or a genuine blocking question remains.
